name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
short_description: Microsoft's enterprise endpoint security platform, offered in Plan 1 and Plan 2, covering preventive protection, endpoint detection and response, automated investigation and advanced hunting.

evidence.quote: It's built on Microsoft Defender for endpoint, the same protection platform large enterprises run
Konkretnie Microsoft Defender for Endpoint zapewnia wymuszanie w czasie rzeczywistym, alerty oraz ochronę DLP
Microsoft also integrates Defender for endpoint directly into AVD session hosts.
Think of it this way, Defender for Endpoint keeps security inside a single room.
